screening_decisions.reason: Staging/reporting overview for endometrial cancer; not a randomized chemotherapy trial in advanced/recurrent disease.

WHO recommendations on reporting cancer treatment; not an RCT and not specific to advanced endometrial chemotherapy.
Surgical pelvic exenteration series for recurrent disease; non-randomized and not cytotoxic chemotherapy.
Randomized comparison of adriamycin vs cyclophosphamide in advanced endometrial cancer.
Randomized phase II trial (cisplatin vs CAP) in progestin-refractory advanced endometrial carcinoma (cytotoxic regimens).
Randomized phase II trial comparing cyclophosphamide vs ifosfamide in advanced/recurrent endometrial carcinoma.
Beta-blockade after myocardial infarction; wrong population/condition.
GOG study comparing two cytotoxic multidrug regimens in advanced/recurrent endometrial cancer with randomization (separate nonrandomized cardiac cohort).
Statistical methods for meta-analysis; not a clinical RCT.

Phase III randomized trial comparing AP vs TAP (adds paclitaxel) in advanced/recurrent endometrial carcinoma.
NSCLC randomized trials; wrong cancer site.
Evaluation of three regimens in advanced uterine corpus carcinoma without explicit randomization; likely non-RCT per title/abstract.
Methodological guidance for time-to-event meta-analysis; not an RCT.
